context: A single-view timeline chart that morphs between four chart types (Bar, Line, Area, Scatter) via an animated scrubber, showing 24 months of synthetic revenue data with play/pause controls and phase indicator labels.
first_impression: Clean and focused — a single dark-background chart with minimal chrome, the Line phase reads immediately and the phase controls orient the viewer without clutter.
what_works: The renderClean function uses opacity cross-fading rather than geometric morphing, making transitions perceptually predictable rather than chaotic; the four phase indicator labels with active-state highlighting give clear orientation at any scrubber position.
what_doesnt: The scrubber track has no phase-boundary markers, so the viewer cannot anticipate when transitions occur without trial-and-error; animation congruence quality cannot be fully assessed from a static screenshot, and the viridis-colored bars/dots create redundant encoding (color and x-position both encode time) that adds visual noise without insight.
